evidence.name: Screen field: Outline thickness
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Outline thickness" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Outline thickness
sections.description: Sets how thick the outline around the bar is, in pixels (default 0, meaning no outline; only applies when the bar is shown). Add an outline when the bar's color is close to the screen background and you want a crisp edge that separates the CTA from content behind it. Once it is above 0, the border color setting appears so you can style the outline.
